div.head: V Atr 26.1
div.ab: ⁊ beo man georne ymbe friðes bote ⁊ ymbe feos bote æghwar on earde, ⁊ ymbe burhbota on æghwylcan ende ⁊ ymbe fyrdunga eac, be ðam þe man geræde, áá þonne neod sy.
⁊ beo man georne ymbe friþes bote ⁊ ymbe feos bote æghwær on earde ⁊ ymbe burhbota ⁊ ymbe bricbota on æghwylcan ænde ⁊ ymbe fyrdunga eac, be þam þe man geræde, áá þonne neod sy.
⁊ beo man georne ymban friðes bote ⁊ ymbe feos bote æghwar on earde, ⁊ ymbe burhbote ⁊ ymbe bricbote æghwar on earde on æghwilcum ende, ⁊ ymbe firdunga, áá þonne neod sy, be þam þe man geræde.
And beo man georne ymbe friðes bote and ymbe feos bote æghwar on earde, and ymbe burhbota on æghwylcan ende and ymbe fyrdunga eac, be ðam þe man geræde, aa þonne neod sy;

Und man sei eifrig bemüht um Besserung öffentlicher Sicherheit und um Besserung der Münze überall im Lande und um Festungsherstellung (und um Brückenherstellung G2 D) in jedem Bezirke und auch um die Landwehr, je nachdem beschlossen wird, immer wenn es nöthig ist.

And let people be eager for the improvement of public security and the improvement of the coinage everywhere in the land, and for the repair of fortifications (and the repair of bridges, G2 D) in every region, and also for military service, as shall be decided, whenever there is need.

And the promotion of public security and the improvement of the coinage in every part of the country, and the repairing of fortresses and of bridges throughout the country on every side, and also the duties of military service shall always be diligently attended to, whenever the need arises, in accordance with the orders given.

And people are to be zealous about the improvement of the peace, and about the improvement of the coinage everywhere in the country, and about the repair of boroughs in every province and also about military service, according to what is decreed, whenever it is necessary.

And the improvement of public safety, the improvement of the currency throughout the land, the improvement of fortifications everywhere, and military service are to be carefully overseen in the manner decreed as the need arises;
